minus_plan.threshold: every Minus Two brain log: no run of >= 0.1 s before x = 73.0 m with the stopping model's bound < 2.0 m/s while the pilot's own horizontal request >= 3.0 m/s

warning.threshold: development cases: the assisted request 1.0 m/s below the pilot's own >= 1.0 s before the wall impact

quiet.threshold: per Straw Bale / Pine Valley brain lap: stopping source active <= 0.5 s/min; stopping-model removal <= 2% and total removal <= 3% of the pilot's own request travel; no more turn-first episodes

slew.threshold: every brain replay: the assist's change per tick <= 15.0 m/s^2 x dt horizontally and vertically

passthrough.note: REPORT, not a gate: motor_assist_eval.passthrough_scenario for every combination (8): a gate arch flown through with a looming-only surface surface_m beyond the ring, read until see_through_m, clear beyond; the lowest horizontal speed from 1.5 s before to 0.5 s after the arch pass. Development (pt17: turn 0/45/90, see-through 1/2 m, seed 17) showed that the governor's own stand-off holds a slowed brain near 1 m/s there, and the fast PD dips too although it passes these Minus arches live at 3.5-4 m/s, so the scenario's looming is not validated against Liftoff

windows.note: REPORT, not a gate (DEVELOPMENT cases): motor_assist_eval.live_window, the logged state at t0 in the surrogate, the brain warmed on the recorded inputs; the pilot's own request from an open-loop replay of the log through this tree's stack and, with the assist, the assisted request from the surrogate's measured velocity with the binding caps and the wall-ahead condition the pilot had at each logged state (the sources come from the logged positions: a surrogate drone that slows falls behind them, so the later bounds are conservative)
